description.value: A developed 44-site BC Parks campground on Swan Lake in Northern BC, with potable water, a covered shelter, and washroom facilities; the gate closes when snow falls, so access is limited to the snow-free season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Swan Lake Park is an operational provincial campground 35 km southeast of Dawson Creek with a grassy campground, day-use area, and active booking system ('Book camping' link, 'Frontcountry camping' under Reservation policies). The site explicitly notes e-bikes are not allowed on trails but are restricted to park roads, providing clear negative evidence for trail e-bike use. OSM supplies operator, capacity (44), and fee=yes; the BC Parks website is the authoritative source for amenity details, though most specific camping amenities (showers, water, toilets) are not described in the fetched text.
concerns: OSM operator tag lists 'Sandstorm North Contracting' (Gmail contact), a private contractor, while the authoritative website is BC Parks (provincial government); cyclists should contact BC Parks directly for reservations rather than the operator email.
No street address or phone number present in OSM record.
Access road is 2 km of gravel off Highway 2 — may be challenging for road-bike touring cyclists.
E-bikes explicitly prohibited on park trails; restricted to park roads only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational BC Parks provincial campground with confirmed booking, suitable for touring cyclists traveling the Dawson Creek area.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM internet_access=no tag aligns with the remote rural location. Campground capacity is 44 sites per OSM. Park is BC's third oldest, established 1918.
